messages:
mira_cs: Heads-up — VegaCore (midmarket) flagged as renewal risk. Activation stalled around week 3, key feature adoption at 18%. Thinking a short, coordinated retention relay to recover momentum.

sam_seo: Ugh. Can you paste the activation cohort numbers? want to see dropoff points. @jordan_se want to join the quick huddle?

mira_cs: Current: 120 seats, DAU down from 42 -> 9 over 10 days. Top missing: multi-user workflow + integrator onboarding.

jordan_se: I can join in 20. Quick ask: can Eng push a temporary coach snippet we can toggle?

kevin_eng: Yep. I can add an in-app coach banner and a step-by-step checklist toggle. ETA today EOD if nothing blocks.

mira_cs: Draft playbook (short window):
```
1) Immediate 48h outreach: email + 20m screenshare offer
2) Flip on in-app coach + step checklist for multi-user flow
3) Grant 2-week feature credit for integrator connectors (no billing change)
4) Measure: DAU, key-event completion, and CSAT after session
5) If uplift < 15% in 7 days -> escalate to tailored success plan
```

laura_success: I'll own the outreach templates and CSAT capture. Sam, can you craft the subject line A/B?

sam_seo: Yep. Two options by 11:30AM. One urgency-focused, one outcome-focused.

mira_cs: playbook-bot: please create task "VegaCore activation-relay" and assign to laura_success + kevin_eng + jordan_se.

playbook-bot: Task created: #VC-422 Activation Relay — assignees laura_success, kevin_eng, jordan_se. Due: in 7 days.

kevin_eng: Pushed banner to staging. Toggle key is `vc_activation_relay_v1`. QA link: https://staging.redwood/VC-activation.

jordan_se: I'll join the screenshare cadences. Mira, can you schedule two 20m slots for next 48h?

mira_cs: Scheduled: Tue 10:00 & Wed 14:30. Invites sent.

laura_success: Sending first outreach now (outcome-focused). Will log responses in the task thread.

sam_seo: Thanks team. Small ask: capture one quote after a session for use in renewal outreach copy.

mira_cs: noted. Closing loop: we'll reconvene after 7 days to judge if escalation needed. :white_check_mark:
